'''Implosion drives''' were a type of [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] powered by an [[implosion reactor]]. They were rarely found outside of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|98|implosion drive}}</ref>
